## Design Context

CleanSlate serves privacy-conscious Facebook and Messenger users cleaning their own activity safely. The UI should feel transparent, technical, and controlled, using a brutalist utility direction with strong contrast, explicit labels, and visible process states. Keep Facebook and Messenger workflows separate, verify the destination page before scanning or destructive actions, and present the sequence as choose, verify, load, review, confirm, execute. Support light and dark themes, keyboard access, readable contrast, and reduced motion.
